# The Most Followed Person on TikTok  
TikTok has seen its fair share of rising stars and shifts in popularity over the years. As of October 2023, the title of the most-followed person on TikTok belongs to Khabane Lame. Hailing from Italy, Khabane Lame has garnered an impressive following of over 161 million followers, securing his place as the reigning champion of the TikTok world. Who did he surpass, and how did these social media influencers make it to the top? Keep reading to find out!
## Who Is The Most Followed Person on TikTok?  
If you’re wondering who is the most followed person on TikTok, look no further than Khabane Lame. His journey to TikTok stardom is an interesting one. Known for his funny videos on a wide range of topics, he gained fame by using TikTok’s duet and [stitch features](https://www.highsocial.com/resources/how-to-stitch-a-video-on-tiktok/) to react silently to absurd “life hacks.” This method defined his initial rise to fame.  
Since then, he has transitioned to posting silent comedy skits that continue to rack up millions of views and likes. Khabane Lame’s rise to the top position began in 2020. His [followers have increased significantly](https://www.highsocial.com/resources/who-has-the-highest-tiktok-followers-on-tiktok/) ever since, solidifying his status as the most followed person on TikTok.
## The 3rd Most Followed Person on TikTok  
Bella Poarch, a talented singer and social media personality from the Philippines, takes the title of the 3rd most-followed person on TikTok. With an impressive and ever-growing following of over 92 million fans, Bella has truly made her mark on the TikTok platform.  
Bella rose to TikTok stardom after a video of her lipsyncing [a popular song](https://www.highsocial.com/resources/popular-tiktok-songs/) went viral. As a singer, her videos resonate with TikTok users worldwide, drawing them into her world of creativity and expression. Bella’s presence on the platform is a testament to the global reach of TikTok, connecting people from around the world through music, entertainment, and fun. Her content is a mix of music, humor, and genuine moments, creating a unique and authentic TikTok experience for her followers.  
Bella’s ability to connect with a diverse global audience through engaging content highlights TikTok’s inclusive and vibrant nature. Her journey serves as an inspiration for aspiring creators who aim to share their talents with the world through the power of social media.

results.content:
# Khaby Lame Becomes the Most Followed Person on TikTok  
Khaby Lame became the most followed person on TikTok on June 23, 2022, surpassing Charli D’Amelio, who had held the top spot since 2020.  
Khabane “Khaby” Lame, who hails from Italy, has amassed a total of [142.8 million followers](https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame?lang=en) on TikTok as of the time this article was written. The American Charli D’Amelio, who has held the record since March 2020, has been overtaken by the silent comedian, who is 22 years old.  
The parodies that Khaby has created of so-called ‘lifehacks’ have amassed millions of views, and they have brought him popularity all over the world.  
Lame’s rise to fame is a testament to the power of social media and the importance of authenticity. He has built a large following by being himself and creating content that is both funny and relatable. He is a role model for aspiring creators and a reminder that anyone can achieve success if they are willing to work hard and be themselves.
## Story of Khaby Lame  
Khaby had little choice but to go back to his parents’ house in Turin, Italy, when the COVID-19 outbreak caused him to lose his job as a factory worker. As a result of the widespread lockdowns that have been implemented, Khaby decided to start using TikTok as a method to distract himself from the monotony of being confined to his house.  
Even though his early videos had him dancing, enjoying video games, and experimenting with the app’s many filters, he did not garner a significant number of views. When one of Khaby’s videos gained widespread attention in November 2020, everything began to shift. Khaby, in response to a video posted by another user that overcomplicated a simple life hack, displayed in silence a more straightforward approach to resolving the issue. Khaby had discovered the secret to success with his now-famous disapproving glare and hand motions.  
Read Here: **Who is Khaby Lame? Biography | Controversy**
## Important Follower Timeline of Khaby Lame  
Khaby Lame is a great example of what a TikTok star is made out to be because it’s the same content that has been uploaded to other social media sites in the past but done so in a unique way that really brings him more attention.  
The number of people following Khaby on [TikTok](https://digitalgyan.org/get-the-most-out-of-tiktok-for-your-business/) continued to rise at an alarming rate, and by April 2021, he had surpassed Gianluca Vacchi to become the Italian user with the most followers.
By July 2021, Khaby had overtaken Zach King to become the user with the most followers on TikTok among males. Khaby also held the record for the second-most followed user.  
When compared to Charli D’Amelio, Khaby continued to make headway, collecting followers at an average pace of three million each month. This was in contrast to Charli D’Amelio, who had just one million.  
Khaby ascended to the top of TikTok in a little over two years after he started his account in the same month that D’Amelio gained the most followers on the platform.  
On TikTok, Charli D’Amelio continues to have the most followers, which is the record for the platform (female). She is also the first [person to reach 50 million followers](https://digitalgyan.org/10-most-followed-sports-personalities-on-instagram/) on TikTok and the first person to reach 100 million followers on TikTok, both of which put her in the Guinness World Records book.
